notes: Added missing schema, core logic, and UI rendering stories to complete feature coverage.

stories.title: Explainability Schema Definition
stories.description: Define a standardized Pydantic schema for explainability objects including source, meaning, and limitations fields, ensuring consistent structure across provider and clinical trial signals.

stories.title: Explainability Core Builder Logic
stories.description: Implement backend logic to construct explainability objects from provider credentials, external links, and clinical trial signals, normalizing differences into a unified format.

stories.title: Frontend Rendering of Explainability
stories.description: Extend chat message rendering to display explainability metadata (source, meaning, limitations) in a readable format within MessageBubble, ensuring clarity without overwhelming the user.
